note: Used when a production does not name its own graphics inset. A named inset in the delivery spec stays the one the package copies. This proposal is still written down so Ron can see the cited standard.

safe_area.note: EBU R 95, Safe areas for 16:9 television production, version 1.1, June 2017. Note 5 says the action safe area is 3.5 percent and the graphics safe area is 5 percent, at the top, bottom, and each side. The publication page is https://tech.ebu.ch/publications/r095/.
